name: query-reclaim-read-cost
body: Every direct `apg query` with no live session runs the shared reclaim classification before its own read, adding two read-only opens (the pending-state probe and the schema-shape diff) to every query; the classification is the gate that keeps an unsaved row from being served, so it stays until a direct-read latency budget says otherwise. Upgrade by sharing one read-only handle across the probes, or by skipping the shape probe when the scan row already agrees, only if direct-read latency becomes a measured concern.
